```{r}
#| include: false
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(htmltools)
library(glue)
library(tidyverse)
library(polite)
library(rvest)
```

```{r}
#| label: loading in datasets, making them match
#| include: false

# original parks list
final_parks <- read_csv("final_parks.csv") |>
  mutate(name = case_when(
    name == "Cascade River State Park Recreation Site" ~ "Cascade River State Park",
    name == "Killen Woods State Park" ~ "Kilen Woods State Park",
    name == "John Latsch State Park" ~ "John A Latsch State Park",
    name == "Nerstrand Woods State Park" ~ "Nerstrand Big Woods State Park",
    name == "Sakatah State Park" ~ "Sakatah Lake State Park",
    name == "O L Kipp State Park" ~ "Great River Bluffs State Park",
    name == "Saint Croix Wild River State Park" ~ "Wild River State Park",
    name == "Helmer Myre State Park" ~ "Myre-Big Island State Park",
    .default = name
    ))

# polygon data by park
park_polygons <- read_sf("Dnr_Stat_Plan_Areas_Prk.geojson") |>
  mutate(legislative_name = str_replace_all(legislative_name, "\\.", ""),
         legislative_name = ifelse(legislative_name == "St Croix State Park", "Saint Croix State Park", legislative_name))
```

```{r}
#| label: scraping missing park data
#| include: false

#list of names of parks with missing info
name <- c("Crow Wing", "Forestville Mystery Cave", "Franz Jevne", "Glendalough", "Grand Portage", "Lac qui Parle", "Lake Louise", "Lake Shetek", "Lake Vermilion-Soudan Underground Mine", "Monson Lake", "Moose Lake", "Rice Lake", "Savanna Portage", "Schoolcraft", "Cascade River", "Father Hennepin", "Myre-Big Island", "Great River Bluffs", "Wild River")

#unique id number in each park url
web_id <- c(139, 148, 157, 167, 173, 197, 214, 220, 285, 238, 239, 250, 259, 263, 133, 142, 175, 244, 254)

# checking scraping allowed
robotstxt::paths_allowed("https://www.dnr.state.mn.us/")

# checking conditions
session <- bow("https://www.dnr.state.mn.us/state_parks/list_alpha.html", force = TRUE)

# making list of urls
urls <- vector("character")
for (i in 1:length(web_id)) {
  url <- str_c("https://www.dnr.state.mn.us/state_parks/park.html?id=spk00", web_id[i], "#information")
  urls <- c(urls, url)
}

# scraping each page
scrape_park_info <- function(url) {
  Sys.sleep(5)
  session <- bow(url, force = TRUE)
  scrape(session) |>
    html_nodes("meta[name='dc.description']") |> # this scrapes the park description
    html_attr("content")
}

# building outside of the function
Sys.sleep(5)
  session <- bow(urls[1], force = TRUE)
  scrape(session) |>
    html_nodes("meta[name='dc.description']") |>
    html_attr("content")

# getting descriptions
description <- vector("character")
for (i in 1:length(urls)) {
  park_url <- urls[i]
  paragraph <- scrape_park_info(park_url)
  description <- c(description, paragraph) 
}

# puts all the scraped data in a table
missing <- tibble(name, description) |>
  mutate(name = str_c(name, " State Park"))

# makes a full dataset with original + missing data
new <- final_parks |>
  full_join(missing, by = "name") |> # this makes sure that rows that don't 
  # match are kept
  mutate(description = coalesce(description.x, description.y), # combines the
         # description rows from each dataset
         type = ifelse(is.na(type), "state park", type)) |>
  select(name, url, address, description, type)

#making a csv
write_csv(new, "parks_updated.csv")
```


```{r}
#| label: parks csv
#| include: false
parks <- read_csv("parks_updated.csv")
```





# added html labels, fixed for extra parks

```{r}
#| label: adding html labels
#| include: false
# joining polygons
parks_sf <- parks |>
  left_join(park_polygons, by = c("name" = "legislative_name"))

# adding html labels of name/description
parks_sf <- parks_sf |>
  mutate(labels = str_c("<p><strong>", name, "</strong></p>
<p><span style='font-weight: 400;'>", description, "</span></p>"))

# applying html
labels <- lapply(parks_sf$labels, HTML)

# making the dataframe sf
parks_sf <- st_as_sf(parks_sf)

# checking class
class(parks_sf)
```

```{r}
#| labels: making map
# making the map!
leaflet(parks_sf) |>
  setView(-93.8, 46.5, 6) |>
  addTiles() |>
  addPolygons(
    color = "darkred",
    fillColor = "darkred",
    fillOpacity = 1,
    weight = 2,
    opacity = 1,
    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
      weight = 5,
      color = "red",
      bringToFront = TRUE),
    label = labels,
    labelOptions = popupOptions( 
      style = list("font-weight" = "normal", padding = "2px 5px", color = "black", "width" = "450px", "white-space" = "normal"),
      textsize = "15px",
      direction = "auto")
  )
```

# scraping wikipedia

```{r}
#| label: scraping wikipedia
#| include: false
session <- bow("https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Minnesota_state_parks", force = TRUE)

# scrapes the tables
result <- scrape(session) |>
  html_nodes(css = "table") |>
  html_table(header = TRUE, fill = TRUE)

# takes the table of interest about parks
try <- result[[1]]

# removes the extra row, removes HA space column, renames Acres column from Size[9]
try <- try[-1,] 
try <- try[,-4]
try <- try |> rename(Acres = `Size[9]`)

# removes . and / and renames parks to help with joining with the parks csv
wikipedia <- try |>
  mutate(`Park name` = str_replace_all(`Park name`, "[.]", "")) |>
  mutate(`Park name` = str_replace_all(`Park name`, "[/]", " ")) |>
  mutate(`Park name` = case_when(`Park name` == "Nerstrand-Big Woods State Park" ~ "Nerstrand Big Woods State Park",
            .default = `Park name`)) |>
  rename(name = `Park name`) |> #renames park name column to match final_parks
  mutate(Acres = parse_number(Acres)) |> #changes Acres from chr to num
  rename(Year = `Year Established[4]`) |> #renames column
  mutate(Year = str_sub(Year, 1, 4)) #removes extra brackets, leaves year

#left_joins the existing park data with the data from wikipedia
with_wiki <- wikipedia |>
  full_join(final_parks)
```

```{r}
#| label: visit totals by season csv
#| include: false
#create csv with visit totals by park
visits <- read_csv("Seasonal_summary.csv")

by_season_visits <- 
  visits |>
  filter (`Unit type` == "State Park") |>
  mutate(Season = str_sub(Season, 1, -6)) |>
  group_by(`Park name`, Season) |>
  mutate(total = sum(`Vehicle visits`)) |>
  distinct(`Park name`, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  select(`Park name`, `System`, `Implementing agency`, `Unit type`, `total`) |>
  rename(name = `Park name`) |>
  mutate(name = str_c(name, " State Park"))

write.csv(by_season_visits, "by_season_visits.csv")
```

```{r}
#| label: visit data and years
#| include: false
#joins visitation data with acres and year established data from wikipedia
numbers <- 
  with_wiki |>
  left_join(by_season_visits) |> 
  select(name, Season, total, Acres, `Year Established[4]`) |>
  rename(year = `Year Established[4]`) |>
  mutate(year = str_sub(year, 1, 4))

write.csv(numbers, "numbers.csv")
```
